reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code, and I read that as a claim anyone can print; I look for NSF or USP, and a brand with zero reviews doesn't get my $30 over the three brands I already know.
objection: No NSF or USP seal and no reviews, so I can't tell if the lab report is real. I also can't see how big the capsules are, and I leave bad reviews on huge ones.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification, or a few hundred honest reviews saying the capsules are small and easy to swallow and the QR report matches the label.
